classification_policy.NOT_SEMANTICALLY_RELATED: Only pairs whose Schema-V2 path belongs to semantic_accounting, which is explicitly prohibited as substitute semantic storage.
classification_policy.SEMANTICALLY_RELATED: Only pairs explicitly present in reviewed curated_semantically_related_candidate_paths.
classification_policy.UNRESOLVED: All other pairs, including lexical-screening-only pairs and pairs absent from prior curated screening.

domain_distinction.reason: The reviewed artifacts contain two distinct 57-element classification vocabularies. The field-class-to-Schema-path relation is therefore defined only over field_class_analysis.v4_field_class; the semantic-unit inventory vocabulary is retained separately for leaf/unit traceability.
